steps.command: if [ "x$BPFREJIT_DUMP_LIVE_JIT" = "x1" ]; then bpftool prog show id ${PROG_ID} > ${WORKDIR}/live_prog_show.txt; bpftool -j prog show id ${PROG_ID} > ${WORKDIR}/live_prog_show.json; bpftool prog dump xlated id ${PROG_ID} > ${WORKDIR}/live_xlated.disasm; bpftool prog dump jited id ${PROG_ID} file ${WORKDIR}/live_jited.bin; chmod 0644 ${WORKDIR}/live_jited.bin; arch=$(uname -m); case "$arch" in x86_64|amd64) objdump_machine=i386:x86-64 ;; aarch64|arm64) objdump_machine=aarch64 ;; *) echo "unsupported JIT dump objdump arch: $arch" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; objdump -D -b binary -m "$objdump_machine" ${WORKDIR}/live_jited.bin > ${WORKDIR}/live_jited.objdump; fi; bpfopt --pass noop --input ${INPUT} --output ${OUTPUT} --report ${REPORT} --prog-type ${PROG_TYPE} --target ${TARGET}; if [ "x$BPFREJIT_DUMP_LIVE_JIT_FAIL" = "x1" ]; then false; fi
steps.name: noop

steps.command: if [ "x$BPFREJIT_DUMP_LIVE_JIT" = "x1" ]; then bpftool prog show id ${PROG_ID} > ${WORKDIR}/live_prog_show.txt; bpftool -j prog show id ${PROG_ID} > ${WORKDIR}/live_prog_show.json; bpftool prog dump xlated id ${PROG_ID} > ${WORKDIR}/live_xlated.disasm; bpftool prog dump jited id ${PROG_ID} file ${WORKDIR}/live_jited.bin; chmod 0644 ${WORKDIR}/live_jited.bin; arch=$(uname -m); case "$arch" in x86_64|amd64) objdump_machine=i386:x86-64 ;; aarch64|arm64) objdump_machine=aarch64 ;; *) echo "unsupported JIT dump objdump arch: $arch" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; objdump -D -b binary -m "$objdump_machine" ${WORKDIR}/live_jited.bin > ${WORKDIR}/live_jited.objdump; fi; bpfopt --pass noop --input ${INPUT} --output ${OUTPUT} --report ${REPORT} --prog-type ${PROG_TYPE} --target ${TARGET}; if [ "x$BPFREJIT_DUMP_LIVE_JIT_FAIL" = "x1" ]; then false; fi
steps.name: noop

steps.command: case "${RUN_TARGET_ARCH:-}" in arm64|aarch64) bpfopt --pass kinsn --input ${INPUT} --output ${OUTPUT} --report ${REPORT} --prog-type ${PROG_TYPE} --target ${TARGET} -- --bytecode-kinsn-mode bulk_memory=disable,endian_fusion=disable,prefetch=disable ;; *) bpfopt --pass kinsn --input ${INPUT} --output ${OUTPUT} --report ${REPORT} --prog-type ${PROG_TYPE} --target ${TARGET} -- --kinsn-mode all=force,wide-load=disable,indexed-load=disable,movbe-load=disable --bytecode-kinsn-mode bulk_memory=disable,prefetch=disable ;; esac
steps.name: kinsn
